Title: Pairon: Your team and AI coding agents, in one shared conversation | Product Hunt
# Pairon. ## Your team and AI coding agents, in one shared conversation. Pairon brings your team and locally running coding agents into a shared conversation. Teammates can add constraints mid-task, run tasks in parallel, hand work across computers, and review changes together. Use Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode with your own agent accounts. ### We’re building multiplayer AI coding for teams. Pairon is a shared development workspace where developers and coding agents collaborate around the same project, across connected computers. If your team works with coding agents, where does collaboration get hardest: sharing context, coordinating parallel work, or reviewing changes? We d love your honest take as we bring Pairon to more teams. We ve also included a Codex project-memory benchmark as supporting evidence: pairon.dev/benchmarks. How does Pairon compare to using Claude Code with GitHub and Slack? What’s the biggest difference in the day-to-day workflow? With Claude Code, GitHub, and Slack, the coding session, team discussion, and PR review can end up spread across different places. Pairon puts the team conversation alongside the coding agent: teammates can add context and follow the work in one shared thread, while Claude Code still runs on a connected computer using its local setup. Day to day, the goal is less re-explaining decisions across tools—the task’s instructions and follow-ups stay with the agent work. The topic of AI being multiplayer is still being discussed as to how to define it, I believe PAIRON is the closest definition we have of what should be multiplayer in AI and the era of vibe coding.. We built it around a simple idea: coding with AI should be something a team can do together, with everyone able to follow the work and contribute. Pairon is a shared workspace for teams using Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode. Connect a computer, choose the project folder, and start a conversation with the coding agent you already use. The agent works on your computer while teammates can join the same room to share context, follow progress, clarify what’s needed, and review changes together. Visit app.pairon.dev, create an account, connect your computer, start a project chat, choose your agent, and invite a teammate to join.

Title: Inline: Multiplayer work with AI, teammates, and friends | Product Hunt
# Inline. ## Multiplayer work with AI, teammates, and friends. Inline is a thread-based chat app for all work, with your team and agents. Launch tags:Messaging•Artificial Intelligence. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Inline. I've been watching Mo build this for what seems like an age but super excited to have been onboarded and trying out the beta. I absolutely love being able to bring my agents in to work with me, and the threading is perfect. Can't wait to see Inline Chat evolve 🤌. @niccoates Thank you Nic for all your support and following along over the years! the thread-based approach makes sense for keeping agent output out of the way of the human conversation, but I'm curious what happens when a human jumps into a thread mid-way through an agent's task and changes direction. does the agent see that as new context in the same thread and course-correct, or does someone need to kill it and re-prompt from scratch? that moment feels like where a lot of "agent working alongside teammates" tools end up feeling clunky in practice.
